items.quote: Excellent cleaning service with very professional cleaners! They followed all requests, had excellent communication, and went above and beyond to ensure a job well done.
Splee has been really amazing in their weekly steam cleanings of my condo. My cats came down with ringworm, which is a nightmare to get rid of, but Splee has kept the carpets clean and sanitized.
I needed carpets cleaned pretty quickly as I had tenants moving in and out. Splee was responsive, able to get in and quickly get the job done!
